what: Plan makes the loop an in-process refactor of an exit-heavy CLI
scenario_or_breakage: Any missed exit in the extracted body terminates before the STEP5_REVIEW_STATUS envelope, leaving SKILL.md with no routable result
suggested_fix: Prefer a child-process loop in run-step5-review.sh or a thin wrapper around the existing --mode diff --round-num CLI, then refactor internals later if still needed

what: Structural LOC gate lacks a per-round pre-coder HEAD
scenario_or_breakage: The plan only adds post-coder-head.txt, while the existing pre-review-head.txt is round-1 global, so round 2+ numstat can compare against the wrong base or fail
suggested_fix: Write round-N/pre-coder-head.txt immediately before apply_findings_with_coder, then write post-coder-head.txt after the coder commit and compute numstat from those two files

what: Loop status matrix omits existing terminal and encoded failure states
scenario_or_breakage: in-scope-filtered-out is currently a successful terminal status, and submodule-violation is encoded as CODER_STATUS under REVIEW_AND_FIX_STATUS=coder-failed, so the new loop can misroute both cases
suggested_fix: Define an explicit per-round status matrix covering REVIEW_AND_FIX_STATUS plus CODER_STATUS, including in-scope-filtered-out as terminal and CODER_STATUS=submodule-violation as STALL_REASON=submodule-violation

what: Test plan assumes private function stubbing that the script shape does not support
scenario_or_breakage: The script executes immediately when IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR is set, so tests cannot simply stub _implement_round_body without adding a new source/test harness contract
suggested_fix: Use existing external-command stubs and child process fixtures, or add a deliberate source-safe main guard/test hook before relying on private function stubs

what: Replacement KV parser is underspecified for mixed stdout
scenario_or_breakage: The current prose says key-based extraction only; the new plan should also require tail-anchored parsing of the final envelope and forbid eval/source so helper output or path-like values cannot influence routing
suggested_fix: Emit the final envelope to a dedicated step5-review-loop.env file or bracket stdout with explicit begin/end markers, parse allowed keys only, and never source child stdout
